epics.title: Service forms a Pekko cluster with resilient membership

stories.statement: Replica nodes form a cluster automatically via Pekko Management and discovery

acceptance_criteria.given: multiple replica nodes start with discovery configured
acceptance_criteria.then: they join the same cluster and each sees the others as Up members

acceptance_criteria.when: a new replica is launched with the same discovery configuration
acceptance_criteria.then: it joins the existing cluster without any manual seed-node configuration

stories.statement: A split-brain resolver using keep-majority determines which side of a network partition survives

acceptance_criteria.given: a cluster split into two partitions of unequal size by a network partition
acceptance_criteria.then: the minority partition's nodes are downed and removed from the cluster

acceptance_criteria.given: a cluster split into two equal-size partitions
acceptance_criteria.then: exactly one partition remains in the cluster and the other is downed

stories.statement: A management HTTP port exposes cluster bootstrap and health endpoints

acceptance_criteria.given: the service is started with Pekko Management enabled
acceptance_criteria.when: another node queries the management HTTP port during bootstrap
acceptance_criteria.then: the port serves the cluster bootstrap endpoint used for discovery-based seed-node lookup

acceptance_criteria.given: the management HTTP port is up on a cluster member
acceptance_criteria.when: a health check request is sent to it
acceptance_criteria.then: the response reflects that node's current cluster membership health status

epics.title: Bucket entities are hosted as cluster-wide sharded singletons

stories.statement: The node-local BucketEntityManager is replaced by Cluster Sharding, so each bucket is a cluster-wide singleton entity addressed by EntityRef

acceptance_criteria.given: a bucket entity is addressed via its EntityRef from any node in the cluster
acceptance_criteria.when: a request is sent to that EntityRef
acceptance_criteria.then: it is handled by exactly one cluster-wide instance of the bucket entity, not a node-local manager

acceptance_criteria.given: a bucket entity that has not yet been activated anywhere in the cluster
acceptance_criteria.then: Cluster Sharding activates exactly one instance of that entity somewhere in the cluster

stories.statement: Bucket entities keep their existing persistence ids and journal after moving to Cluster Sharding

acceptance_criteria.given: a bucket entity with events previously persisted under the single-node BucketEntityManager
acceptance_criteria.when: that bucket is now hosted via Cluster Sharding
acceptance_criteria.then: its persistence id is unchanged and its prior event history is read from the same journal

acceptance_criteria.given: a bucket entity hosted via Cluster Sharding persists a new event
acceptance_criteria.then: it is written using the same persistence id and journal configuration as before sharding was introduced

epics.title: The projection is distributed across the cluster and rebalances on membership change

stories.statement: The projection runs as ShardedDaemonProcess workers across N slice ranges instead of one instance

acceptance_criteria.given: the projection is configured with N slice ranges
acceptance_criteria.when: the service runs as a cluster
acceptance_criteria.then: the projection work is split into N ShardedDaemonProcess workers, each responsible for one slice range

acceptance_criteria.given: a healthy cluster running the projection
acceptance_criteria.then: each configured slice range is being processed by exactly one worker at a time

stories.statement: Projection slice ranges are rebalanced across ShardedDaemonProcess workers when cluster membership changes

acceptance_criteria.given: a node hosting one or more projection workers leaves the cluster
acceptance_criteria.then: the slice ranges it owned are reassigned to workers on remaining nodes

acceptance_criteria.given: a new node joins a cluster already running the projection
acceptance_criteria.then: some slice ranges are redistributed to a worker on the new node

epics.title: Journal migrated to a clustered store

stories.statement: Migrate the journal to a clustered store and rewrite persistence ids to the new sharded scheme so bucket entities can be hosted anywhere.

acceptance_criteria.given: bucket entities persist to the existing journal under their current persistence ids
acceptance_criteria.then: their events are readable from the clustered store under the new sharded persistence ids

acceptance_criteria.given: a bucket entity written before the migration
acceptance_criteria.when: it is rehydrated after the migration
acceptance_criteria.then: its state is recovered from the clustered store rather than the old journal
